implemented_locally: Audit events require exact tenant, organisation, project and environment scope, actor, policy version, target, correlation and timestamp fields.
Audit events are append-only, idempotent and hash-chained with tamper-evident digests.
Exact-scope exports use an independent per-scope hash chain and are independently verifiable from the returned events.
Secret-shaped fields are redacted before persistence.
Data classification is explicit for public, business, message, knowledge, credential, audit, billing, telemetry and evidence records.

verification.full_command: cd packages/atlas && npm run metadata:write && npm run metadata:check && npm test -- --testTimeout=30000 && npm run build && git diff --check

limitations: This is local filesystem audit and redaction proof only.
No OIDC/SSO provider, KMS, production secret manager, RLS, hosted export service or key-rotation environment was available.
No SOC2, ISO, GDPR, HIPAA or PCI compliance claim is made.
CI, staging, production, billing and commercial evidence remain unavailable.
verdict: ATLAS-BMR2-P6-003 = BLOCKED_EXTERNAL / LOCAL_PROVEN — bounded tamper-evident, independently verifiable per-scope export and secret-redacting audit controls are implemented and tested locally; hosted identity, KMS/secret-manager and compliance evidence remain unavailable.
